notes.title: HUGE bug fix update (and Qol + New Content)
notes.content:
Hey all!! Sorry for the delay on this one..we just kept finding things we wanted to tweak to make the game as great as possible. So without further ado, here are the changes from this update:

[h2]QoL Updates:[/h2]
[list]
[*] With the keyboard, you can now press Ctrl + Left click to move an entire stack from your inventory
[*] Created separate controls for 'Use Items' and 'Interact with Objects.' Using items if left click (or gamepad button west) as always. But interacting with objects/NPC is now right click (or gamepad button east) which makes things clearer, and prevents all sorts of annoying little mishaps from happening.
[*] Fishing resistance is no longer changed if the game is in sped-up mode. 
[*] Path tiles can be placed underneath buildings/objects now
[*] Objects can be placed on top of dirt now
[/list]

[h2]New/Updated Content[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a cute little groundhog critter.
[*] Changed nearly ALL the art for the objects in the game (it's subtle, we wanted the line thickness to be standardized with all items to add a feeling of cohesiveness)
[*] Changed the graphic for the selected object indicator in your inventory when playing with gamepad (so it no longer looks like there are 2 mouse pointers)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a soft lock issue where you could lose your fishing rod before acquiring the higher level rod. You can now sell/buy the lower tier rod.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the fishing UI bar and sound FX to get stuck if you fished overtop of the NPC
[*] Fixed a bug that caused fish to get caught too early before hitting land
[*] Fixed a bug where released fish would sometimes swim backwards onto the land
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented item descriptions from auto hiding when dialogue with the NPC starts.
[*] When you load in at nighttime, the correct ambience clip will now play.
[*] When you load in at nighttime, if it's a 'cloudy day' - cloud shadows will no longer show up.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from scrolling with the mouse in the recycle menu
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the NPC to spaz out when waiting to start the tutorial dialogue.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to fish out of the water if you were 1 tile away from the water.
[*] Fixed a few typos in the dialogue. Not a bug, I know...but didn't know where else to put this.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could permanently change the size of the inventory icons under the right circumstances
[*] Fixed a bug where the NPC could get stuck in his tutorial text trying to walk to his location.
[*] Fixed a bug where the NPC could go offscreen during the tutorial text and you couldn't read it.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could sometimes craft mulch without all the proper ingredients
[*] Fixed a bug where you could sometimes still keep walking even while picking up debris on the ground
[*] Fixed a bug where the NPC could get stuck in his walk animation during the tutorial text.
[*] Fixed a bug where the NPC could walk away from you after you initiated a conversation with him
[*] Fixed a bug where the build indicator texture could get stuck and never turn off until you restarted the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where under the right circumstances, you could end up getting the incorrect item from the evolution machine.
[*] Swapped the icon for the yellow stone path, as i incorrectly assigned the orange stone path icon to it.
[*] Cleaned up the sound for the debris pickup. There was a super annoying 'buzz' that I didn't notice until I played with headphones.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 CONTENT Update!!
notes.content:
We're PUMPED to announce the release of version 1.1 for Cropolution!

Here are all the changes you can expect to see:

[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*] Island Debris (sticks, rocks, moss, bones, barkworm skin) - to be used for crafting. (Spawns randomly around the island each morning.)
[*] Garbage Can (mostly for debris, or if you want to get rid of something rather than sell it for some reason.
[*] Recycle Center (basically a crafting center.) In it: (so far) you can craft:
[list]
[*] Paths (bone, cobblestone, wood, and stone.)
[*] Bone tower
[*] Mulch (another way to earn some $ in the early game.)
[/list]
[*] Scientist NPC (with LOTS of dialogue. He always has funny stories to tell, but his dialogue is context sensitive, so his dialouge will change with your progress and based on what activities he's doing around the island. [b]Plus, he serves as a tutorial for new save files.[/b])
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can move EVERY building/item in the game now (except the museum.)
[*] Non-Tile items have a visual indicator letting you know whether you can place them or not.
[*] The bug net is less frustrating to use now, as obstacles won't stop you from casting it now.
[/list]

[b]Visual Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the grass tiles to have a more textured look
[*] Updated the water to better suit the game
[*] Added some shoreline foam around the island in the water.
[*] Fixed some icon artifacts in the museum recipes icons.
[*] Added some particles to the mushrooms when you walk over them.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Rain particles should now fit properly on ultra wide monitors
[*] Fixed a bug where the interact popup wouldn't go away if you interacted with 2 objects that were too close together.
[*] Fixed a particularly tricky-to-find bug that sometimes didn't fire events properly if you exited the museum donation center.
[/list]

There's more on the roadmap! And We're super eager to release v 1.2 when it's ready!
Hope you enjoy the updates!

notes.title: Bug (Insect) Adjustments + Bug (glitch) fixes!
notes.content:
CHANGES:
- Bugs will now despawn outside of their spawn time window
- Bugs have a daily maximum number of times they can spawn (though this number is NOT affected by the bug net, so you won't be punished for catching them by hand with the bug net, but bug jars are a little less OP now.)
- Increased the frequency of the bug spawn check to ensure they spawn at exactly the time they should (before the check only happened every 5 seconds)
- Adjusted a few bug behaviors to fit better with the new spawn rates.

BUG FIXES:
- fixed a bug where your inventory would get locked and your fishing rod UI bar would get stuck above your head if you had the fishing rod equipped when you left the museum
- fixed a bug where your inventory would get locked and your fishing rod...blah blah blah, same as above, except it happened when you opened a Chest/bug jar/mulch box

notes.title: MAJOR update
notes.content:
NEW ITEMS:
 - the small or large bug jar. These are TRAPS that, once set, will automatically catch bugs that wander near, and will store them until you're ready to pick them up! Will make earning money and collecting those bugs you need MUCH easier.

NEW Features:
- Ultra wide screen support has been added!
- An option to remove the in-game popups has been added to the menu
- in the museum, if you walk up to the crop, bug or fish statues, you'll now be able to see which ones you've already released, which makes tracking your progress much easier.
- Item descriptions on applicable items now show what SWARM RESISTANCE (pesticide and seeds) - so you know how good your odds are before planting.

Reworked UI:
- the Shop has been re-worked from the ground up. Cause I hated the old one, and this one is much nicer.
- Also, the items in your shop are categorized and ordered nicely now, instead of appearing in the order you unlocked them in.
- Added some shadows/outlines to text that was difficult to read. And changed the item description UI for the same reason.

Bug fixes:
- fixed an annoying issue where, the first time you load into the game, if you clicked anywhere before reaching an interactable object, you'd have to select it twice.
- fixed a bug where certain items would have the evolution icon in your inventory that shouldn't have it.
- fixed a rare issue where certain bugs would sometimes walk backwards.
- fixed an inventory issue where sometimes the wrong item would equip after loading into the game.
- fixed a bug where your inventory icons would stay faded if you opened a UI screen while holding onto an item with your mouse.
- fixed a similar bug to the above one, but with the gamepad virtual mouse icon.
- fixed a bug where if you used your shovel to pick up an item, you would also dig in that spot on the same click.

Hope you enjoy the changes!

notes.title: v 1.0.3 update
notes.content:
NEW FEATURE - You can now turn OFF the swarm in the main menu if you so choose. If you're looking for a cozier experience, this would be it.

QoL update - You can now HOLD DOWN the use button to use: fertilizer, pesticide, shovel, seeds. and scythe!!!!!! (Watering can is staying the same for now, as we possibly may want to utilize holding down the use button for a charge up on a future upgraded watering can.)

QoL update - The scythe now uses a circle trigger with a larger radius for picking up crops, making it much easier to pick up crops around your sprinkler or other interactive objects.

Bug Fix - Fixed an issue where if you pressed Esc (or North on GP) to exit a UI screen in the museum, after donating everything in your currently equipped slot, you wouldn't be able to properly equip new items or use them.

Bug Fix - Fixed an issue where, if you were playing with the gamepad, donating your fishing rod in the musem would simply duplicate your fishing rod.

Bug Fix - In a scroll view area in the UI, it will no longer automatically scroll to something selected if you simply highlighted it with your mouse.

Bug Fix - Fixed an issue where selling and evolution machines weren't correctly resetting the rapid fire use with your mouse, which was making it difficult to only sell or evolve 1 item at a time.

Re-balance - Increased sell value of SpiritSlug to 500

Re-balance - Decreased the price of 4 directional sprinklers to 750

Re-balance - Decreased the price of 8 directional sprinklers to 2000

Re-balance - Increased the natural swarm resistance on the level 11 crop (gigfruit) to be 40% (combined with pesticide it's now 100% fully protected.)

Misc - Updated some bug descriptions to make it more obvious where they appear on the map

Misc - the main menu navigation options are more intuitive now

- Adjusted some item description texts
- bugFix - you can no longer unpause the game while viewing the controls
- bugFix - opening and closing the shop really fast no longer makes the button grow to ridiculous sizes :)
- Changed the order of a few museum recipes
